# Bridge commands

## status

Print bridge status as JSON: static config plus a connectivity probe (`--probe false` for the offline static payload)

```text
Print bridge status as JSON: static config plus a connectivity probe (`--probe false` for the offline static payload)

Usage: bevy_copilot status [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --host <HOST>        Host of the BRP HTTP endpoint (env BEVY_BRP_HOST, default 127.0.0.1)
      --probe <PROBE>      Probe whether the configured app answers `rpc.discover`: true|false (default: true; `false` gives the offline static payload) [possible values: true, false]
      --port <PORT>        Port of the BRP HTTP endpoint (env BEVY_BRP_PORT, default 15702)
      --compact <COMPACT>  Compact (single-line) JSON output instead of pretty: true|false [possible values: true, false]
  -h, --help               Print help
```

MCP peer: `brp_status`
